name: craftlight
description: Six skills of one discipline: brief (decision by dialogue before the task), task (task router + CRAFT.md map), plan (decomposing an initiative into waves of tasks, above task), debug (systematic root-cause hunting without editing code), code-review (review without edits), and craft-graph (a graph of decisions and gotchas). Principle: ceremony proportional to the task — start light, escalate on explicit signals.
